title: Glyph kit: a sample filled glyph
about: A format sample for the kit's { fill } glyphs, drawn by hand for the kit: it is not a letter of any alphabet and is traced from no source. Its cell (sample-fill-cell.png) is a synthetic image rendered from this same outline and softened, made only to show compare.mjs's overlay; it is not a source crop.

letters.name: Sample fill (not a letter)
letters.strokes: a ring whose bowl runs down into a flared wedge foot, with one counter
letters.note: Format sample only: an outer outline and one counter inside it, drawn evenodd; it uses M, L, C, Q and Z.
